metadata.description: Likely used to define the domain for cookies in the UI application.
metadata.note: Empty value may cause cookie functionality issues.

suggestions: Provide a valid domain name, e.g., 'example.com'.
Ensure the domain aligns with your deployment environment.

metadata.description: Likely used to define the name of the cookie for the UI application.
metadata.note: Empty value may cause cookie name configuration issues.

suggestions: Provide a meaningful cookie name, e.g., 'session_token'.
Ensure the name is unique and descriptive for its purpose.

metadata.description: Defines the login type or authentication method for the UI application.

suggestions: Ensure the value corresponds to a supported login type.
Document the login type configuration for team reference.

metadata.description: Appears to be a password used for site authentication or administrative purposes.
metadata.note: Sensitive information that should be encrypted or stored securely.

suggestions: Store this value securely using environment variable encryption tools or secret management services.
Rotate the password periodically to enhance security.
Avoid hardcoding passwords in the environment; use secret vaults or injection mechanisms instead.

metadata.description: Appears to be a username, likely an email, used for site authentication.
metadata.note: Sensitive information that should be protected.

suggestions: Store this value securely using secret management tools.
Ensure the email is valid and corresponds to an active account.
Avoid exposing usernames publicly to reduce attack vectors.
